name: web-success-badge-pill-in-mint-green-with-arrow
title: Mint green pill badge 'Success | New feature added ↗' with a lighter inner tag
whatItIs: A mint capsule with a light green border, an inner pale 'Success' tag, the text 'New feature added' and a diagonal arrow in dark green.
whatItMeans: Positive and calm; a green tonal pill signals success without shouting.

vocabulary.definition: A status colour showing a positive outcome.
A capsule using shades of one hue.
A small pill announcing a new feature.
A lighter area inside a pill.
